notes.title: Berry's Mod, Tools, Customization and Blocks!
notes.content:
Change Log

v0.01.m0
Customization
-Change colors of objects

Sandbox Map
-A new sandbox map added

Sandbox Tools
-A set of tools exclusive to sandbox map(can be enabled in other maps via console by typing "sandbox")
-Bloon Tool: Spawn bloons
-Pin Tool: Pin two objects together
-Thruster Tool: Add a thruster controlled with arrow keys
-Remover: Remove objects
-Rope Tool: Add rope between two objects
-Scaler: Scale objects
-Duplicator: Duplicate object
-Constraint Remove: Remove already attached constraints like pins and ropes

Other Changes
-Weight property of objects have been reworked (It is a lot more realistic now)
-Proper version management
-Bug fixes

[previewyoutube=j4eEM9U637U;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Puzzle Mode Arrives!
notes.content:
[b]Moving In now has a new play mode: Puzzles.[/b]

In this mode you need to match photo references to finish the puzzles. Each puzzle will give you a different set of photos which you will need to match by placing the object in correct spots. When you reach to a 100% match score you can finish the puzzle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43650643/c83e0c37dc43dd1f98e3406883ead7bb191bbf20.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43650643/00295c076a70a9feceaf90a6b59b4a6cccd716cb.png[/img]

[b]Currently you can try out these 3 puzzles for the demo version.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43650643/6578ca97b5973e83f5513010767f3f62f8e9e8d2.png[/img]

[b]Also blahaj is back!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43650643/0291c5d13c523275eceebbc2fcec7c7d438d75d0.png[/img][/b]

notes.title: Moving In Now Looks Better!
notes.content:
[h1]Item Browser[/h1]

[b]Now you can browser through your items with an in game online shop.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43650643/8fab2ced4af221de1347e88bc0ab60e95fd0697d.png[/img]


[h1]Reflections[/h1]

[b]Moving In now looks way better with proper reflection probes. This change affected the overall look of the game.[/b]

[b]BEFORE[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43650643/5bfcbef042337531ab5c5d74f9608e5fe39f32d0.png[/img]

[b]AFTER[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43650643/eae5ffc6977a3941637ad552aa408f5baebc37b4.png[/img]


[h1]New Interactions![/h1]

[b]A bunch of objects received new quirky interactions.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43650643/602d2490b1c5a7f19e7e47b8385a74f985d4920a.png[/img]


[h1]Material Changes[/h1]

[b]Materials are updated to be more vibrant and colorful.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43650643/0e232caa176a08c7611c0b3e556f230fc2fab71d.png[/img]

[h1]Music Player[/h1]

[b]Now you can listen to chill lofi while decorating your house! We have a really cute music player as well![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43650643/112d1b5ab91a6d2fa74056d5780d1038d98a1acc.png[/img]

[h1]Other Changes[/h1]

+New Player Controller
+Custom Music
+Experimental Night Time Mode
+Bug fixes

notes.title: Small Quality of Life Update Before Next Fest
notes.content:
[b]On Screen Controls![/b]

Now there are on screen controls to help you better learn the controls :D With this game doesn't really need a tutorial level so that has been removed from the game. You can disable the on screen controls from the settings menu!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43650643/b4ef8c0936583c734a090b96c01e845ab52ebc92.png[/img]

[b]Also introducing Hand Painted Filter![/b]

You can enable this on settings screen! It is off by default :D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43650643/ba399364bcdb23223e87d101b6ea63ebe86a5734.png[/img]
